HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Armor Clash is a strategic tank battle game where you command powerful fighters to create the strongest army and defeat your enemies. Understand vehicle properties and counter your opponents to win!
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Drag and drop tanks to positions on the field.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Place objects in a limited area, not too close to the opponent's commander.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Use strategic placements and upgrades to win battles.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Experience dramatic combat gameplay with intense competition.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Build the strongest army by understanding vehicle properties and countering opponents.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Receive bonuses and upgrade your fighters with each victory.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Accumulate in-game money to buy high-end fighters and diversify your army.
